nodes.name: Joint construction
nodes.gloss: One speaker leaves a clause open; the other closes it in a handful of words; the first ratifies; the closer is allowed one extension. The completion is a contribution, not an answer — it can amend as well as finish, and the amendment costs nothing.

positions.name: open the clause and leave it hanging

nodes.quote: "…decoding some what somebody else is saying to us that is a different neural circuit — " / "we don't have the web" (1:221–222); "whatever, the working memory of the person, you can calibrate" / "exactly that" (2:169–171). Completion attested in both directions.
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: No store shape has a completion position. P3 read-back restates what was already said; N301's position 2 supplies what was NOT yet said and has it adopted. The metaphor handover (2:233–240, the road trip) is this node at arc scale — completion, then extension, then ratification-by-naming-the-handover — and is recorded as an arc of N301, not a separate mint.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes, held loosely. Clause-completion mechanics vary with word order, but the position — closing another's utterance and having it ratified — attests wherever two people finish each other's sentences.

ladder.K1: DIES. The completion becomes an answer to be graded; ratification becomes marking. Zero completions in pod-0's 231 rows, zero in health's 438 turns. Remnant: P3/F9 — you may restate, never complete.

nodes.name: Digression-and-return
nodes.gloss: A detour is taken — flagged or unflagged — and the thread survives because BOTH parties hold it. The return marker ('where were we?') can be answered by either side; the thread is joint property, and losing it entirely is recoverable because the partner has a copy.

positions.name: resume, detour optionally claimed as evidence

nodes.quote: "I have no idea what the original question was there - something about methodology?" — and the partner supplies it (1:59–60); "And where were we? the connection and the welcome… Oh yeah. So why he was doing it." (2:57)
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N17 interruption-and-bank looks backward at a broken thread and BANKS it; N302 is the return machinery — and the store records N17's recovery half as unattested (the next session is lost). The within-conversation return is attested three times here. The bank half of digression behaviour (1:291–293, 2:285) lands on N17 and is not re-minted.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. Any two people who wander and come back attest it.

ladder.K1: survives — you can digress across an information gradient
ladder.K2: the licence to digress becomes a grant from whoever controls the encounter; remnant is health's N110 signposting, the controller narrating the thread for both
ladder.K3: DIES as joint property. When one party holds the record, position 4 changes hands permanently — 'where were we' has exactly one answerer. At rung 0 even the tape is a shared toy (2:144, the tease prosecuted by invoking the recording).

nodes.name: The specimen
nodes.gloss: Mid-claim, the partner is turned into the live experiment — taught the thing, tested on the thing — and the result, INCLUDING failure, is read back into the claim. At rung 0 the specimen cannot fail: a failed recall is data for a claim about forgetting.

positions.name: the partner is enrolled as the live case
the result is folded back into the claim

nodes.quote: "I told you the Welsh for fish was pysgod…" / "thinking 'pys', is it a bit like puss? And I think Cod is a fish. Isn't it?" / "If we leave that. Yeah. and I come back in a couple of hours…" (1:322–334)
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N4 instruction has the recipient act on instructions for the recipient's own sake; health's N102 has a body acted on under consent. Here the partner's performance is EVIDENCE for a live claim, jointly owned. One direction only in this corpus (Aran on Tom) — tracked to who owns the demonstrable method in the passage, not to the interviewer role (mapping doc §7).
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. 'Close your eyes — what colour is my shirt?' attests it anywhere.

ladder.K1: survives — the specimen passage itself runs across a local information gradient
ladder.K2: a consent position materialises: you may not enrol a party who can refuse the encounter without asking
ladder.K3: gives the test its instrument only
ladder.K4: TRANSFORMS into health's N102 consent-and-narrated-act — consent formalises, narration becomes duty, the result changes owners. The O3→O101 pattern, on a node.

nodes.name: The reported claim too big to hold
nodes.gloss: A third party's claim is reported with its source, its size is registered ('my brain is already hurting'), it is tried on jointly — and it is left unresolved. Nobody owes a verdict; the parking of the verdict IS the shape.

positions.name: report the claim + its source + its epistemic status
try it on jointly ('she would say…')

nodes.quote: "There's no such thing as a word. / Yeah. / There aren't any." … "I don't think I can keep up with my brain is already hurting" (1:198–202); "I read that and I thought this is the April the first edition! And then it wasn't!!!" (4:194)
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N8 recommendation and N14 premise audit both end in a verdict position (uptake; ground supplied or conceded). N304's defining position is that the verdict is jointly withheld — no store shape parks a claim.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. 'Apparently they've proved…' around any table.

ladder.K1: DIES. Against an information-holder someone owes a verdict ('is that true, doctor?'); position 4 vanishes. Remnant: N8 with grounds, or N104 norm-referencing.

nodes.name: The proxy pitch
nodes.gloss: One party performs, to the other, how they pitch the OTHER's own thing to strangers. The owner audits, ratifies and extends — and may adopt the improvement into the thing itself.

positions.name: perform the pitch of the partner's thing
owner extends; the improvement may be adopted

nodes.quote: "how I introduce your method to people is I say… Holy Dickhead Batman…" / "and giving people permission to play around with it…" (1:233–242)
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: N8 recommends to the person who asked; F9 restates to verify. N305's position 3 — the owner adopting the proxy's improvement — exists in neither, and is exactly the position K1 kills.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. 'This is how I describe your cooking to people.'
nodes.thin: One attestation. Thin, and flagged as thin — strikeable with one word.

ladder.K1: DIES. Pitching the holder's own material back becomes a read-back to be graded; position 3 vanishes. Remnant: F9, hardening to F104 by rung 4.

nodes.name: The co-staged scene
nodes.gloss: Both parties build one hypothetical scene across turns, each voicing roles inside it — the shops, the people, the council — handing the enactment back and forth. The scene itself carries the argument; stepping out of it ends it.

positions.name: the partner voices a role or the counter-role
read the scene back into the live argument

nodes.quote: "'listen, if you do this, we will pay you at the end of the month, 700 tokens…'" / "'we'll refund you in full - if you can't spend it…' so you get people going 'well, I haven't been able to spend it, please refund me in full'" (4:289–298)
nodes.why_not_an_existing_node: The 23-move inventory held enacted dialogue as intra-turn (one speaker staging voices). Across-turn joint enactment has no store home: N301 completes a CLAUSE; N306 co-authors a WORLD, and the voicing positions are its own. The Method Pod's scenes 15's cast partner is a minted cousin, recorded there as mint — this is its attestation-bearing sibling shape.
nodes.smoke_test: Passes. Two friends jointly acting out 'and then he'll say… and then you say…' attests anywhere.

ladder.K1: survives — the corpus stages scenes about worlds only one party knows well
ladder.K2: DIES. You may not script the voice of a party who holds refusal authority over the real scene. Remnant: N4 instruction ('you'll want to say…') — the scene collapses into coaching.
ladder.K4: scripting the other's role over their own body/stake becomes N102's territory

moves.name: So what you're saying is
moves.test: The listener hands back a compression or a NAME for what the speaker just built — sharper than the original — and the speaker ratifies and ADOPTS it into the joint position. The restatement is a contribution, not a check.
moves.quote: "That's literally how cancer works." / "Exactly. Yeah." (2:207–210); "so what you're saying really is… currency is the great leverage." (4:179–180)
moves.why_not_F9: F9 checks that the hearer got it; being wrong costs the checker nothing and adds nothing. F301's restatement is offered as an upgrade the originator may adopt — the adoption position is what F9 lacks, and it is exactly the position K1 kills (mapping doc §6). The listener-names-it summit shape (2:207–210) is this move with a name instead of a compression, deliberately consolidated rather than minted twice.
moves.position: BUILD → COMPRESS/NAME IT BACK → ratify + adopt. Position 2.

ladder.K1: the gift form dies — the K1-holder's claim is not yours to upgrade; the family survives as F9 verification at rung 1 and F104 solicited read-back at rung 4. One act, four shapes, one per rung — the axis's clearest specimen.

moves.name: It proves nothing — accept it anyway
moves.test: An epistemic flag prices the speaker's own authority down BEFORE the delivery — and thereby LICENSES delivery at full strength. The flag is not a withholding; it is what buys the confidence.
moves.quote: "Iost my foot in that river please accept my anecdotal evidence!" (1:349); "I'm out of practice there and haven't spent a lot of time thinking about it, but if I was allowed to give one roll of the dice…" (2:294–295)
moves.why_not_F15: F15 'I'm not sure' downgrades and stops — the uncertainty is the answer. F302 downgrades and then delivers at full strength — the uncertainty is the licence. Consolidates the inventory's anecdote-with-flag (4), provisional flag (11) and status flag (18): one shape, three sizes.
moves.position: FLAG → full-strength delivery → uptake. Position 1, decorating the delivery turn.

ladder.K4: INVARIANT — health's N109 'I won't promise what I can't be sure of' is this move at rung 4, where the bound IS the reassurance (S105). The strongest trunk result in this file; belongs beside #283's O7.

moves.name: The shared line
moves.test: A line minted between the parties is redeployed later as a joint tool — as argument, tease or shorthand — its ownership common and its provenance contestable in play.
moves.quote: Minted: "…please accept my anecdotal evidence!" (1:349). Called back two sessions later: "Oh, I accidentally got into bed with a crocodile" (4:455). Ownership contested in play: "Politics is already dead, it just doesn't know it yet." / "I've been saying this for a little while: Politics is already irrelevant. It's already dead…" (4:242–246)
moves.why_new: No store move rests on the parties' own conversational history. Consolidates callback (8), co-owned line (20) and the deployed razor (13).
moves.position: Deploy the shared line → recognise / contest provenance → hold jointly. Any position.

ladder.K2: the provenance-tease branch dies; the deployment survives
ladder.second_axis: Gated by SHARED HISTORY, an axis the ladder does not carry — no kind kills a callback; the absence of a past does. Named as an axis-candidate, not smuggled onto this ladder.

moves.name: Comment on the medium
moves.test: Either party comments on the conversation's own machinery — the tape, the hour, the un-recordable gestures — as play, and the machinery may be used AS a tool by either side.
moves.quote: "[It's a pity that the recordings can't pick up my pathetic attempts to act this out. Isn't it?]" / "I think they'll get it - he's banging on the side of the chair." (1:213–215); "because this is recording and since you just called me mad, I would like to point out…" (2:144)
moves.why_not_N110_or_N101: N110 signposting is the encounter-CONTROLLER narrating what happens next; health's N101 is the medium pre-negotiated as a contract. F304 is the medium as a shared toy, touchable by either party mid-flow. The N101 kinship is the cleanest graded-transformation pair across the corpora: same content, hardened from play into licence as kinds accrue.

ladder.K2: the joke position dies — the medium belongs to the encounter-controller; remnant N110/N101

moves.name: Absorb and build
moves.test: A counterexample or concession — the partner's or the speaker's own — is welcomed and folded into the claim as an upgrade. The counter is treated as data FOR the frame, not against it.
moves.quote: "but you can't, for example, say red but… but of course been in the middle of conversation, you're saying, I'd like one that's red, but I don't mind all that much. Yeah, exactly. So we've got a little bit of information there." (1:120–123); "And that's true. That's right. That's what you have to do, but it's incredibly painful if you haven't prepared for it." (1:254–255)
moves.why_not_F16: F16 concedes and HOLDS the original position against the counter. F305 upgrades the position WITH the counter — the claim that exits is better than the claim that entered. Consolidates the counterexample-absorbed summit shape and concession-then-build (7).
moves.position: COUNTER → absorb as data → build. Position 2.

ladder.K1: absorption becomes adjudication — the information-holder rules on the counter rather than folding it in
ladder.K4: FORBIDDEN — absorbing the acted-upon party's counterexample is what health's N106 stop-and-verify exists to prevent; the halt replaces the absorption

moves.name: Exactly where I'm about to go
moves.test: The partner's contribution is ratified as the speaker's own planned next move — the floor merges rather than passes. Only honest between parties with equal access to the terrain.
moves.quote: Tom supplies the Ebbinghaus critique unprompted; Aran: "exactly where I'm about to go. Yep." (1:315–319)
moves.why_new: F1 accepts; F10 continues; nothing in the store merges two speakers' forward plans. Distinct from F301: the reformulation compresses what WAS said; pre-emption ratifies what was ABOUT to be said.
moves.position: CONTRIBUTION → ratify as own planned move → continue on the merged line. Position 2.
moves.thin: One clean dialogic attestation. The thinnest id in this file; minted because the position is unmistakable on the page and the store holds nothing for it. Strikeable with one word.

ladder.K1: DIES — across an information gradient the ratification position cannot be honestly occupied; no higher-rung form exists, which is why nothing like it appears in pod-0 or health
